notes: No remote command channel exists, so transport is "none". The FS25 dedicated server has no RCON, no stdin console and no write API. Its admin web interface (default http://<host>:8080, https on 8443; credentials from the <initial_admin> username/passphrase block in dedicatedServer.xml) has Home, Savegames, Mods, Log Files, Profile, Settings, Journal and Logout pages - it starts and stops the game and manages settings, mods, savegames and logs, but no consulted source shows a kick, ban or player-moderation control in it. Kick and ban are in-game only: a player enters the admin password in the Farm Management screen (reached with ESC), then uses the buttons "Kick", "Block from server" and "Show Blocked Players" -> "Unblock" on the player list; the GPORTAL wiki independently describes the same web-panel-sets-password / in-game-login model and names no typed command. There is no broadcast/say command at all. The Web API enabled on the Settings page is read-only and so is not recorded as a transport: the FSG docs list it as three links (XML, map image, savegame files), and the DJWoodZ bot's code pins the paths as GET http://<host>:8080/feed/dedicated-server-stats.xml?code=<web code> and /feed/dedicated-server-savegame.html?code=<web code>&file=careerSavegame; the stats feed carries connected player display names with no persistent player id, and the bot sends nothing back. The gs-prefixed console commands (gsMoneyAdd and friends) are a client-side developer/cheat console enabled with -cheats plus <controls>true</controls> in game.xml, and include no kick, ban, say or player-list command. appId is the game's 2300320: GIANTS publishes no separate Steam dedicated-server app, and dedicatedServer.exe ships inside the game install (TroubleChute states no separate download or licence key is needed; hosts that rent FS25 servers use the same binaries).
